# Generated by `bazel run //platform/buildScripts:plugin-model-tool` - do not edit.
# Whether a module can be packed as a plain `lib/modules/<module>.jar` is a repo-global AND over what every
# plugin's own model states, and the JPS-to-Bazel converter folds it. These are the community modules a
# community-only checkout would fold differently, because the plugins that decide them are in the ultimate
# half: `+` is a candidate, `-` is not, and the sign is the whole-repo answer either way. A `+` line names the
# module libraries merged into its jar after the module name, because the fold agrees on that set as well and a
# community-only checkout cannot see it.
#
# The converter states these rows and records them in `bazel-targets.json`; this run only writes them out. The
# fold reads the project model, each plugin's residue and each member's own descriptor, and the converter is
# its one implementation - a second one here is the two-reader hazard the dev-distribution leaves exist to
# remove.
